releaseNotes: Reports now compares periods: a six-month income and spending trend, how your spending is tracking against the rest of the month, and a change figure on every total and category that compares like for like - two days into a month are measured against the first two days of the last one, not against the whole of it
A new day-of-the-week breakdown showing which days cost you most
Money paid into investments is no longer counted as spending - your past expense totals may now read lower than before, which is the correction, not a loss of data
Investments still come off your balance, because the money has left your account
Fewer categories out of the box. Unused ones you never touched were removed; any category you have actually recorded against is kept, with all its transactions
Upgrading from 3.6.0 installs over the top - no uninstall needed. From 3.5.0 or earlier you must still uninstall first, after syncing
